answer: Honest identities pass beacon checks; forged ones fail by design. A VRF beacon draws 5% of identities each epoch. Honest agents submit a work proof within 2 epochs, while clones must fabricate proofs. A reef of attestations clears every check for the honest; forged accounts face a 7-member jury, and absence freezes rewards for 6 epochs. A second miss slashes 50% of the stake. An umber flag marks double misses, and a knoll of repeat offenders is barred for 12 epochs. Cost math: 1,000 clones lock 120,000 units, and at 5% drawn per epoch the expected loss is about 6,000 units.
